tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Electrofusion Machines supplied should have minimum 3 years of Warranty period
The executive engineer has the right to reject the tender at any time
Delivery schedule within 15 days of agreement
Financial turnover of last three years shall be attach & any 3 years
Registration Certificate issued by registration authority to be enclosed by the tenderer with the technical bid
Location and address of the Factory
Executed similar type of one contract or supply order in last three year valued not less XX% of APT (as per bid document)

Bidder should submit one sample item to RWSSD Raichur Division after the tender submission, during technical evaluation for the verification inspection, The sample will be evaluated as a part of technical assessment
Unconditional bank line of credit from any nationalized/scheduled bank.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have supplied the Electrofusion Machine similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80. % of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years. The items offered for supply shall be of latest manufacturing, should not be more than 2 months

in case the tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer , has supplied, the Electrofusion Machine satisfactorily at least 30% of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be satisfactory. (Attach Work done certificate Issued by should not be Below the Rank of Executive Engineer.)
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance for both (a) and (b) above, in proforma under Section XII. refer bid document

Turnover certificate for the past 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) of the firm should be submitted. Turnover should be equivalent to amount put to tender in any 2 years. (CA certified copy with UDIN NUMBER)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Unconditional bank line of credit from any nationalized/scheduled bank.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.
NSIC Certificate has to be produced if applicable

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate by CA for Five years for 2021-22 to 2025-26 along with UDIN Number
Authorization Letter from manufacturer for authorized representative/dealer
ISO certificate regarding QC of the of their item
Registration Certificate issued by registration authority for the manufacturing of Field test kit/Chemicals
same material supply workdone certificate of XX percentage as per bid document, Must be not below the rank of Executive Engineer
The bidder has to be Registered under NSIC, Certificate has to be produced.
